content.approval_scope: Parent operator authorized independent-copy exclusions on 2026-10-09; preserve original test and all remaining label bytes; no resplit search or relabeling.

decoder.implementation: Pillow stored raster converted to RGB; no EXIF transpose
decoder.limitation: Decoded-RGB equality is additional conservative screening, not a near-duplicate or acquisition-independence proof.

filename_group_audit.limitation: AIR numeric prefixes are original-image IDs, not verified geographic scenes; Ship groups are only unverified sensor/polarization/date filename proxies.

limitations: This is a fixed local image split, not a verified official or acquisition-disjoint protocol.
Sensor/polarization/date filename groups are unverified proxies, not recovered scene IDs.
Cross-split exact byte/RGB duplicates are excluded from lower-priority splits only.
Within-split duplicate images and differing source annotations are preserved, not adjudicated.
No near-duplicate or geographic/acquisition-independence claim is made.
The audit is not a claim that every original label is correct.
content.protocol: existing seed2026 split with test-first byte/decoded-RGB cross-split decontamination

log_observation.limitation: tqdm batch progress is not proof of completed epoch; controls_by_epoch is checked separately.

deferred_dataset.trust_model: producer source audit and coordinator publication; not a security signature
deferred_dataset.verification: ready publication + source audit + full staged image/label manifest hashes

cuda_identity.method: process-local CUDA runtime device_count for known PyTorch 1.13 UUID parser bug

content.initialization_limitations: Same seed, not common-tensor alignment across Original/DS, placement, state dimension or differing trend-kernel shapes; initial tensor hashes are recorded.
content.initialization_policy: seeded scratch construction; BN stride-probe statistics reset
